c.reason: The plugin registries take a host-language callback, so the C API exposes no registration call and therefore no clear/unregister call to pair with one. There is no C function to name, so this fixture is deliberately not documented for c. Every other language keeps it.

skip.reason: The plugin registries take a host-language callback, so the C API does not expose registration or the clear and unregister calls that pair with it. With no C function to name, the built-in c snippet recipe has no function identity and the fixture cannot be documented for c. Every other language keeps this fixture.
